name: strands
title: Strands
description: A dark glass sphere with a bright spectral band twisting inside it. It swells and leans as a voice assistant listens or as the pointer moves near it.
use: A voice or AI assistant needs a focal, ambient indicator that reacts while it listens.
avoid: It is a full-size WebGL scene with its own loop, so it is heavy for many instances and needs a sized parent.
a11y: The canvas is hidden from assistive tech and carries no status text, so the listening state is only visual. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A round dark translucent orb edged with a soft glassy rim, on a black field. A band of light crosses its middle, warm red and orange above a white-hot core and cool blue below; small grey captions sit at the bottom.
behaves: The band ripples and bulges continuously, guided by a simulated speech level, while its glow and lean respond to a nearby pointer or a click. It settles to a calm hum when listening stops.
customise: Colours, strand count, speed, amplitude, waviness, thickness, glow, taper, spread, refraction, dispersion, glass size, energy, listening and light mode are props.
weight: heavy: A fragment-shader scene renders every frame at up to 2x device pixel ratio.
